title: How to organize the changing station | Nursery
description:
A pad you can work at with one hand staying on your baby the entire time.

This is the Changing Station in the Nursery. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Diapers, wipes, and cream all touchable without moving your feet or lifting your hand off your baby, a lined pail within one step, two spare outfits in the drawer directly beneath the pad, and a pad surface with nothing stacked on it.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Clear the whole dresser top.
Straighten: Stand at the pad and sweep your free arm through its full arc.
Shine: Wipe the pad after every change and pull its cover off for a hot wash weekly.
Safety: Keep one hand on your baby the whole time the strap is off, with no exception for reaching a shelf, because a
Standardize: Tape a card on the wall beside the pad with the counts you restock to: eight diapers in the caddy, one wipe pa
Sustain: Restock the caddy back up to the numbers on the card during the last change before bed.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Everything you touch during a change is reachable with your feet planted and one hand on your baby.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/nursery-the-changing-station.html

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
